points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable ade1953 clean build succeeds in network-disabled cfd-bench with documented external and benchmark roots; evaluator foundation_serial test passes (1/1).

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp handles case/output, restart/resume and collective input errors; no full CLI/solver campaign independently rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Config, mesh, partition, flux, reconstruction, residual, solver and output modules, with a large continuation/Newton solver.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Trust policy excludes external authorship investigation; no internal solver executable wrapper found.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON drives mesh and physics; generic CGNS reader and controls without two-mesh-only branch.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Root-only METIS, neighbor state/reconstruction and global reductions exist. Submitted rank comparison uses different executable hashes and cannot isolate rank causation.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Collective error handling and admissibility gates exist, but residual/order completion gate does not require stable forces for two laminar final results.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Contestant reports 14 CTests/13 Python tests; evaluator clean build and foundation_serial pass, while validator cannot establish force stability.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source modular; later immutable tip ade1953 tracks 47 figure PDFs. Raw canonical outputs and supporting postprocessing manifest remain workspace evidence.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
